QuestInfo.name: Building a New House For Blackbull
QuestInfo.0: You hear Blackbull in Perion is building a new house...
QuestInfo.1: You run into '#p1020000#' again, the guy whose house you helped fix. He has a much harder task for you this time, though. His cousins from #m100000000# are all moving to Perion, so he needs to build a brand new house, from scratch! He needs the deed to his land, but it was stolen from his son by #r#o3230100##k. You'll need to go see the Curse Eyes who roam the Northern Forest areas...
QuestInfo.2: So that all of Blackbull's cousins could move to Perion, you got him the item he requested. It was really tough, and you hope he doesn't ask you to BUILD a house for him next time...

0.0: Hey, it's you! Gotten pretty famous since last we met, eh? Anyway, thanks to you, my house was fixed up just fine. But now I have a new problem. My relatives from #m100000000# want to move here. I need to build a house for them, but I don't have the materials to build with...
0.1: Well hey, can you get the stuff to build the house for my cousins? So many relatives are coming that the #t4000018# and #t4000003#es you got for me last time just won't do. I'll tell you what I need. What do you say?
0.2: I hope you can find me 20 pieces of #b#t4000022##k, 2 #b#t4003000#s#k, 10 #b#t4000003#es#k, and the lost #bdeed to the land#k. My son had the deed when he was attacked by monsters. Please hurry, before they eat the deed!
0.3: The monsters who took the deed are called #r#o3230100#s#k, and they live in the North Forest. Can you bring me the deed, along with the materials for building a house? I will make sure you are well compensated. Good luck!

1.0: This is the deed that my son lost! And you brought all the materials to build the house! Thank you so much! My relatives can all live in #m102000000# now!
1.1: Okay, now choose the scroll of your liking... They are all 10% scrolls.

yes.0: Hopefully the scroll I gave you will be useful. Here's also a little bit of money. I'll never forget your help. I'm going to tell everyone! We'll probably meet again...

item.0: You still haven't gotten everything? I need you to find 20 pieces of #b#t4000022##k, 2 #b#t4003000#s#k, 10 #b#t4000003#es#k, and the lost #bdeed to the land#k. Please hurry, before they eat the deed!
